contracts_rationale: The Mission changes an internal text classifier; it adds no endpoint, payload or CLI surface, and the GatingClass vocabulary is unchanged (C-001).
purpose_context: The issue-matrix approval gate reads hex colours as issue numbers, treats commit-SHA evidence citations as work targets, and gates every #N in research and plan prose. Operators then hand-record not-applicable rows for issues the Mission owes no work. This Mission narrows the detector and the one classifier so only real, in-scope issue statements gate approval.
purpose_tldr: Stop the issue-matrix gate from demanding verdict rows for colours, commit citations and research-note numbers.
source_description: Issue #7808: hex colour values read as issue references; bundled with #5297 and #5516 (operator ruling: one Mission, all three).
